hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "git[^|;&]*commit" && printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qiE "co-authored-by:.*(claude|anthropic)"; then echo "Blocked: commit message contains a Claude Co-Authored-By line. Remove it and commit again." >&2; exit 2; fi
